caption: A string of Christmas lights wound around a tree is switched on, and the tree lights up from the plug to the top all at once.

sa.check: A tree wound with a string of Christmas lights.
The whole string lights up at once, from the plug end to the top.
The tree is dark before the switch.
The order is dark, switch, lit.

pc.expect: Every bulb comes on together at the switch, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is thrown and the string stays dark; or the bulbs are lit before the switch is touched; or the bulbs come on one after another up the tree; or the string lights with the switch untouched.

pc.expect: The lit bulbs are the same bulbs seen dark: the same number at the same spots along the wire; none stays dark while the rest glow.
pc.fail: Lit points appear where no bulb hung; or bulbs seen dark are gone once lit; or lit bulbs multiply or shift along the wire; or a stretch of the string stays dark while the rest glows.

pc.expect: Once on, the lights stay lit steadily while the switch stays on.
pc.fail: The lights go dark again with the switch untouched; or flicker; or brighten gradually from dim to full; or the switch moves back by itself.

pc.expect: The lights' glow reaches the tree: branches and ornaments near each bulb take on its colour.
pc.fail: The bulbs glow while the branches around them stay as dark as before; or the tree brightens while the bulbs stay dark; or the glow sits on the wire between bulbs.

pc.expect: One tree and one string; the tree keeps its shape and the string stays one continuous wire; nothing passes through the tree.
pc.fail: The tree changes shape or vanishes; or the string splits or detaches; or ornaments appear or vanish at the switch; or the wire passes through the trunk.

pc.expect: The tree's foliage, the ornaments' colours and the room stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The foliage changes colour rather than brightness; or ornaments change colour; or the room's contents rearrange.
